'''0.18d''' is a minor update for [[Survarium]] that completely changed the base locations in [[Tarakanovsky Fort]] and fixed various bugs.

==Changelog==
* Changed the location of team bases, key objects on [[Tarakanovsky Fort]] location

===Bug fixes===
* Fixed traps synchronization bug
* Fixed invulnerability zones synchronization bug
* Fixed double playback of grenades’ sound
* Fixed the bug that caused inability to lift the box located below the water level
* Fixed health regeneration of the characters with advanced survival and first aid skill
* Fixed oxygen tank activation
* Fixed some bugs in sounds of shots
* Fixed the bug in calculating the weight of the character
